description: Na₃NiO₂ is Pb(Zr_(1-x)Ti_x)O3-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Ni-O bond lengths are 1.79 Å. O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-21°.
